title: A Data-Free Physics-Informed Neural Operator for Level-Set Interface Advection
abstract: arXiv:2609.38195v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Operators for interfacial problems are trained on reference solutions produced by the solver they are intended to replace. This work develops a data-free physics-informed neural operator for level-set interface advection, in which the interface is the equation's unknown and the operator maps an initial interface to the full spatiotemporal trajectory under a prescribed flow. Training uses only the transport residual and a geometric constraint; no reference solution enters the objective at any point. A spacetime Fourier backbone emits the entire trajectory in one pass, and the initial condition is imposed by construction rather than by penalty, which removes the competition between the anchoring term and the residual that otherwise arises when no solution data are available. translated_title: 一种用于水平集界面对流的无数据物理信息神经算子
translated_abstract: 界面问题的算子通常是用它们所要替代的求解器生成的参考解来训练的。本工作开发了一种用于水平集界面对流的无数据物理信息神经算子，其中界面即为方程的未知量，该算子将初始界面映射为在给定流场下的完整时空轨迹。训练仅使用输运方程残差和几何约束，目标函数中任何环节都不引入参考解。一个时空傅里叶骨干网络一次性输出整条轨迹，初始条件通过构造方式施加而非通过罚项施加，这消除了在缺乏解数据时锚定项与残差之间通常出现的竞争。监督算子和混合算子在完全相同的架构、函数族、计算预算和测试集下进行训练，并在全文中作为基线报告，用于量化……
tldr: 提出一种无需任何参考解数据的物理信息神经算子，仅凭输运残差与几何约束进行训练，并通过构造方式施加初始条件，可一次性输出水平集界面在给定流场下的完整时空演化轨迹。
en_tdlr: A data-free physics-informed neural operator is proposed that maps an initial interface to its full spatiotemporal trajectory using only the transport residual and a geometric constraint, with the initial condition imposed by construction to eliminate competition between loss terms.
